comparison.objective: Hold a cord taut and cut it safely with a knife; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Tensioning a deformable cord while applying a blade differs from preserving a threaded setting under jam-nut torque.
comparison.success_condition: Cord severed away from hand and anchor, knife safely released versus locked stop angle and successful repeated cycles.
comparison.reason: Bimanual reaction control is generic; cutting and threaded adjustment are different tested abilities.
